title: Shots fired in Syracuse’s University neighborhood leads to heavy police presence
summary: A shooting incident occurred Friday night (10/31/2026) in Syracuse's University neighborhood around 10:58 p.m. on the 900 block of Lancaster Avenue, prompting a heavy police response involving both Syracuse Police Department and Syracuse University Department of Public Safety. This incident highlights public safety challenges in a dense neighborhood area near the university.
